source_card_proposals.paraphrase: Experience concerns individual cases; art grasps general causes and can teach. General knowledge without recognition of the particular can fail in practice. Aristotle ranks the master-worker above the manual worker through knowledge of causes.
source_card_proposals.use_boundary: No modern equality-of-expertise thesis; paraphrase of selected Ross digital text.
source_card_proposals.quotation_status: No new quotation admitted; selected digital wording read, no Greek/print collation claimed

source_card_proposals.paraphrase: Aristotle distinguishes substance or essence, matter or substratum, source of change, and purpose or good as causes. He introduces his review of predecessors under the inquiry into causes.
source_card_proposals.use_boundary: Only I.3 opening selected; no whole-book recovery or derivation of Taylor’s sixfold claimed.
source_card_proposals.quotation_status: No new quotation admitted; selected digital wording read, no Greek/print collation claimed

source_card_proposals.locator: IV.3, non-contradiction formulation and Heraclitus reference
source_card_proposals.paraphrase: The same attribute cannot both belong and not belong to the same subject at the same time and in the same respect, with additional qualifications against dialectical objections. Aristotle refers to what some believe Heraclitus says.
source_card_proposals.use_boundary: Aristotle’s characterization does not replace the separately transmitted B51 or adjudicate its wording.
source_card_proposals.quotation_status: No new quotation admitted; selected digital wording read, no Greek/print collation claimed

source_card_proposals.locator: V.3, merit criteria within the full V.3–5 selected witness
source_card_proposals.paraphrase: The parties agree that distribution should follow merit while differing over its measure: democrats identify it with free status, oligarchs with wealth or noble birth, aristocrats with excellence. Distribution relates shares and persons proportionately.
source_card_proposals.use_boundary: Develops q001; political criteria remain those reported by Aristotle, not independent evidence of every constitution.
source_card_proposals.quotation_status: No new quotation admitted; selected digital wording read, no Greek/print collation claimed

source_card_proposals.locator: V.5, reciprocity and Pythagorean attribution within complete V.3–5
source_card_proposals.paraphrase: Aristotle attributes an unqualified identification of justice with reciprocity to the Pythagoreans and rejects its adequacy for distributive and corrective justice. Proportionate reciprocity serves exchange between unlike producers.
source_card_proposals.use_boundary: Does not establish a universal ancient harmonic social law. Read with existing q002 on demand, money and sufficient commensurability.
source_card_proposals.quotation_status: No new quotation admitted; selected digital wording read, no Greek/print collation claimed
